TwinSlide/TwinSlide.contract: Two persistent eight-step tracks are running, pitch-distinct, selectively accented and selectively sliding; both audio outputs remain available for stereo routing.

authoring.prompt: REQUIRED persistent musical state: set data.forgePattern={"tracks":[{"steps":[8 step objects]},{"steps":[8 step objects]}]}. data must contain only forgePattern. Each step object has exactly {"semitones": integer -12..36, "gate": true, "accent": boolean, "slide": boolean}. All 8 steps in each track must be gated, each track must use at least 3 distinct pitches, and every adjacent pitch, including step 8 back to step 1, must change. Use selective accents and slides, and make the two audible pitch sequences different. Set ForgeModular/LFO param id 0 Rate to 0.0 exactly. Keep TwinSlide slide-rate param 13 in 0.1..2.0 and accent-depth params 62 and 71 in 0.1..1.0 (omitting them uses proven defaults 0.75, 0.5, and 0.5). Do not use params 21..52 for notes: those are momentary editor buttons, not pitch values.
